item.title: Syracuse Dominates the Boards, Beats BC 93–59 for Eagles’ 17th Straight Loss
item.description: Syracuse used a strong second quarter to gain 21-point halftime lead over Boston College women's basketball, and BC was not able to catch up as the Eagles suffered their 17-straight loss in a 93–59 blowout.

item.title: More Than a Game: Berry Reflects on the Lessons and Connections Gained From ‘Jeopardy!’ Tournament of Champions
item.description: Cameron Berry didn’t think he’d ever return to the screen after winning $26,600 from Jeopardy!, but the assistant director of applications and data analysis became a local star upon his reappearance on Jeopardy! Tournament of Champions (TOC).

item.title: Luke Kuechly Selected to Pro Football Hall of Fame Class of 2026
item.description: On Thursday night, it was announced that former Boston College football standout Luke Kuechly has been elected into the Pro Football Hall of Fame Class of 2026.

item.title: ‘Half His Age’ By Jennette McCurdy: A Disaster You Can’t Stop Reading
item.description: Half His Age walks a fine line between exposing and condemning the crime of this romance and inadvertently fetishizing pedophilia.

item.title: The Cost of an Education at BC
item.description: As I sauntered into 2150 Commonwealth Ave., it became evident that something was wrong—not in the way that I existed, or in the existence of those around me at the time, but in the polarity between me and a culture I had not so much as glimpsed in my entire life.

item.title: No. 11 BC Suffers 6–1 Upset Loss to Vermont
item.description: No. 11 BC suffered a 6–1 loss to Vermont at home on Friday night, marking its worst loss of the season as the Eagles head into the Beanpot Final.

item.title: No. 3 BC Falls to No. 2 Northwestern 20–12 in Season-Opener
item.description: No. 3 Boston College lacrosse fell to No. 2 Northwestern 20–12 in Friday's season-opener, as the Wildcats used two 7–2 quarters to come away with a win.

item.title: BC Gains Key Hockey East Points in 4-3 Overtime Win Over No. 13 Holy Cross
item.description: Boston College women's hockey had to overcome six penalties and a two-goal deficit in the third period, but the Eagles took down No. 13 Holy Cross 4–3 on Friday afternoon for their second straight win.

item.title: 2025–26 Softball Preview: A Year of New Beginnings
item.description: With a new head coach and having to fill some key holes in the roster left by outgoing seniors, Boston College softball comes into 2026 littered with fresh faces. It will be up to BC head coach Beth Krysiak and her young squad to overcome those challenges and find success.

item.title: Miami Pulls Away Down the Stretch, Hands BC Fourth Straight Loss
item.description: Although Boston College men's basketball made a comeback after going down 10, and even stole a brief one-point lead, Miami closed it out down the stretch to hand the Eagles their fourth-straight loss.
